exemptionClaims.basis: Synthetic exercise entry: a police complaint about the export is under consideration. Not assessed.

description.nature: A departing employee exported client files from the client management system to a personal cloud folder.
description.location: Client management system; export destination outside the company's control.
description.likelyImpact: Client financial and family details held outside the company; at least one client contacted by another firm.
description.consequencesForPrincipals: Unsolicited contact by other firms; possible misuse of financial details.
description.eventsCircumstancesReasons: The export happened after the employee resigned and before access ended. A data-loss alert was raised but not reviewed for four days.

findingsOnResponsiblePerson.summary: An internal user with legitimate access exported the files; deletion could not be confirmed.

implemented: Written request to delete the exported files
proposed: Block uploads to personal cloud storage from managed devices
safetyMeasuresForPrincipals: Treat unexpected offers that quote your loan or policy details with caution
remedialMeasuresAgainstRecurrence: Review data-loss alerts within one working day
